verdict.rationale: Perplexity's 'Computer' MCP feature and Assistant claim to browse the web, execute code in a sandbox, connect to 400+ services, and perform tasks like drafting emails/booking reservations (perplexity-docs-9, -17, -18, -19, -29, -30), but this operates in a cloud browser/sandbox rather than the user's own local applications. Hands-on community reports directly contradict reliability: the Computer research feature 'often fails to trigger via the UI, and when it does work, sessions frequently stall without returning an answer' (perplexity-comm-7). Missing for 10: evidence of actually operating local desktop applications (not just cloud sandbox/browser), and independent corroboration of successful end-to-end task completion.
